description: This Java source file defines step definitions for Cucumber tests related to dashboard functionalities in the OrangeHRM application. It includes step implementations for verifying widget visibility, chart rendering, API response checks, and navigation flows within the dashboard page.

classes.name: DashboardSteps
classes.description: Step definitions for dashboard-related Cucumber scenarios, including widget visibility, chart checks, and API verification.

methods.name: theUserNavigatesToTheDashboard
methods.description: Navigates the browser to a specified dashboard URL path.

methods.name: theDashboardPageShouldLoadSuccessfully
methods.description: Verifies that the dashboard page loads successfully by checking URL and page elements.

methods.name: theWidgetShouldBeVisible
methods.description: Checks whether a specific widget with a given name is visible on the dashboard.

methods.name: theQuickLaunchWidgetShouldDisplayShortcutIcons
methods.description: Verifies the visibility of shortcut icons within the Quick Launch widget.

methods.name: eachShortcutShouldHaveAValidNavigationTarget
methods.description: Ensures each shortcut in Quick Launch has a navigation target.

methods.name: clickingEachShortcutShouldNavigateToTheCorrectPage
methods.description: Samples navigation verification after clicking shortcuts (not fully implemented).

methods.name: theChartShouldBeVisible
methods.description: Verifies a specific chart is visible on the dashboard.

methods.name: theChartShouldRender
methods.description: Checks if the specified chart has rendered.

methods.name: theWidgetShouldDisplayPendingActionCounts
methods.description: Verifies if a widget displays pending action counts.

methods.name: theWidgetShouldDisplayTheCurrentDate
methods.description: Checks if a widget displays the current date.

methods.name: theActionSummaryAPIShouldRespondWith
methods.description: Logs API response expectation based on widget presence; actual network verification not implemented.

methods.name: theTimeAtWorkAPIShouldRespondWith
methods.description: Logs API response expectation for the 'Time at Work' API.

methods.name: theLeaveAPIShouldRespondWith
methods.description: Logs API response expectation for the 'Leave' API.

methods.name: theSubunitAPIShouldRespondWithValidData
methods.description: Verifies subunit API responds with valid data based on chart rendering.

methods.name: theLocationAPIShouldRespondWithValidData
methods.description: Verifies location API responds with valid data based on chart rendering.

methods.name: theDashboardShouldOnlyDisplayWidgetsPermittedForTheESSRole
methods.description: Checks that the dashboard displays only permitted widgets for ESS role.

methods.name: adminOnlyWidgetsShouldNotBeVisible
methods.description: Verifies admin-only widgets are hidden for non-admin users.

methods.name: theUserShouldBeRedirectedToTheLoginPage
methods.description: Verifies redirection to the login page.

methods.name: isWidgetVisible
methods.description: Helper method to check if a widget with a given name is visible.
